---
title: "compareinstances"
sidebarTitle: "compareinstances"
description: "Iki Instance object degerinde saklanan dahili Instance reference degerlerini karsilastirir."
keywords: ["compareinstances","Cache"]
---

<div className="real-function-page">

```lua
compareinstances(first: Instance, second: Instance): boolean
```

## Argümanlar

<ParamField path={"first"} type={"Instance"} required>
Karsilastirilacak ilk Instance object.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path={"second"} type={"Instance"} required>
Karsilastirilacak ikinci Instance object.
</ParamField>

## Dönüşler

<ResponseField name={"equal"} type={"boolean"}>
Iki Instance object degeri ayni dahili reference degerini iceriyorsa True.
</ResponseField>

## Örnek

Iki Instance object degerinde saklanan dahili Instance reference degerlerini karsilastir.

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

print(compareinstances(Players, Players))
print(compareinstances(Players, ReplicatedStorage))
```
